card.name: Commas before names in settler lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', or linking words in old local-history passages right before another pioneer's personal name, such as lists of early settlers, builders or merchants.

modes.label: Comma in name lists
modes.description: A comma between full names in a list of early settlers or businessmen.
modes.example: James COWEN, Isaac BAILEY<<,>> James B. DUNKIN, A

modes.label: Link before a settler's name
modes.description: A word like 'that', 'was', 'and' or 'of' just before the name of a first settler or child.
modes.example: The first white person born in the town of Genesee<< was>> Damon Stewart, whose widow, who was

card.writes: It favors given names like Noah and Elijah and disfavors other name and place fragments, so it predicts a first name next.
card.plain: It notices spots in old county-history text where another early settler's name is about to be given.
